decisions.story_title: Microsoft MDASH AI scan finds 59 Linux kernel bugs including 21-year-old CVE-2026-74544
decisions.reason: Substantive standalone finding: Microsoft's MDASH AI-driven scanner reports 59 Linux kernel security issues, headlined by CVE-2026-74544, a cls_u32 shift-out-of-bounds flaw present for at least 21 years. Distinct CVE and narrative from the existing CVE-2026-74628 TCP flaw story, so mint a new story.
Reports Apache HTTP Server 2.4.71 released Nov 11 fixing three flaws including a critical memory-corruption RCE. Same Apache advisory stream as the existing story.

decisions.story_title: Qilin ransomware claims breach of University of Texas at Arlington
decisions.reason: Alleges Qilin compromised UT Arlington campus-wide MachForms infrastructure with stolen-data samples. Different victim from the existing Qilin/AXE-EXPERTS story, so it belongs in its own story.
Windows SignDrop zero-day bypassing the CLFS kernel driver for SYSTEM access; matches the existing story of the same title.
Node.js security update for 26.x/24.x/22.x fixing 16 vulnerabilities (7 high). Matches the existing Node.js advisory story.
Documents the Citrus Ransomware group using VLESS-over-HTTPS tunnels and the Sn00py RaaS loader against Russian companies. Matches the existing Citrus Ransomware story.
